summary: BIO-key International filed an 8-K reporting that its September 3, 2026 annual meeting lacked sufficient votes for Proposal 4, which seeks Nasdaq Rule 5635(d) approval of up to 1,236,668 shares issuable upon exercise of warrants from an August 10, 2026 warrant inducement transaction. Quorum was present, but that proposal was only described in an August 24, 2026 proxy supplement. The meeting was adjourned and reconvened to October 2, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. at company offices; the July 15, 2026 record date and all proposals remain unchanged. This is a routine meeting adjournment, not a special situation.
